title: MIÑIN
bio:
MIÑIN Presents Moments In Club(Monthly)

Brian De Loera (aka MIÑIN) is a DJ/artist from Los Angeles, California. He has been on the dancefloor (and pits) for at least two decades at various legendary parties such as Mustache Mondays, Rhonda, L.A.U.R.A., Machine Club and more. He co-runs the party BREACH with Venganza, which has been at the forefront of cutting edge dance music that spans from Club, House, Vogue, EBM and more. He is now carrying the mantle for parties in Los Angeles that are not only inclusive to all genders, races and sexual orientations - but will get you on the dancefloor that honors his predecessors and moves LA nightlife into the next generation.
